decisions: Structural type prefixes come from compiled CSharp TypeNamePolicy and are used by its encoder and parser.
Stable identities distinguish source nominal structs/enums, builtin enum names, product labels and structural wrappers. Display spelling is not a substitute.
Function frames count UTF16 code units, not UTF8 bytes; function body text does not replace bound signature and specialization facts.
Source declaration identities must remain available before runtime canonicalization. No runtime type flags or registration admission are weakened.
